title: PostgreSQL composite index p99 tail gain vs write overhead
what: orders_join p99 drops 6.1x (150 -> 25 ms, -126 ms) while order_insert adds +4.1 ms p50

reader_questions.question: By how much did the composite index cut orders_join p99 latency?
How many queries per endpoint back each percentile?
What tradeoff appeared on the write path?
reader_questions.expected: order_insert latency rose by ~+4.1 ms at p50 due to index maintenance.
